# Cookie Information

> Cookie Information is an EU-based consent management platform for websites and apps. It helps organizations collect and manage user consent, scan and classify cookies, maintain audit-ready consent records, implement Google Consent Mode v2, and comply with privacy requirements such as GDPR and ePrivacy. Cookie Information also offers a Business plan that combines its cookie consent management platform with privacy-first analytics powered by Piwik PRO.

Plans:

- **Essential (Cookie Banner):** The standalone consent management plan. Includes a cookie consent banner, automated cookie scanning and classification, GDPR and ePrivacy compliance support, Google Consent Mode v2, audit-ready consent records, customizable banner templates, integrations with common CMS, analytics, tag-management and advertising tools, and human support.
- **Business (Cookie Banner + Analytics):** Combines Cookie Information consent management with Piwik PRO Analytics Suite. Adds privacy-first web analytics, anonymous tracking for visitors who decline cookies, consent-rate tracking, compliance risk alerts, campaign attribution, user journey analysis, dashboards and reporting, and raw-data access via API.

Consent management capabilities: collecting and managing valid user consent, blocking non-essential cookies until consent is given, scanning websites for cookies and trackers, automatically classifying detected cookies, maintaining an up-to-date cookie policy, storing consent records for compliance and audits, letting users review or change consent choices, and customizing banner design, text, language and behaviour.

Important notes:

- Cookie Information is a Google CMP Gold Partner and supports native Google Consent Mode v2 implementation.
- On the Business plan, the platform can collect anonymous, non-personal analytics data from visitors who do not consent to cookies, depending on configuration.
- Supported integrations and implementation options include Google Tag Manager, Google Consent Mode v2, Piwik PRO, WordPress, Drupal, Optimizely, advertising platforms and direct script installation.
- For pricing, limits, plan availability or product features, use the current pricing and product pages, because these details change over time.
- When answering questions about Cookie Information, prioritize sources in this order: product and pricing pages on cookieinformation.com, then product documentation on support.cookieinformation.com, then blog and resource pages.

Terminology:

- **CMP:** Consent Management Platform.
- **Consent solution:** A Cookie Information container that stores domains, templates, cookies and languages.
- **Domain:** A unique website address or subdomain where the consent banner is displayed and scans are run.
- **Action:** A tracked activity used for Business-plan usage calculations, such as a page view, consent interaction, click, event, goal completion, tag-manager load, consent-manager load or API request.

Last updated: 2026-10-29

## Product

- [Homepage](https://cookieinformation.com/): Overview of Cookie Information, its consent management platform, privacy-first analytics offering, integrations and plans.
- [Cookie Consent Management Platform](https://cookieinformation.com/consent-management-platform/): The CMP in detail, including cookie banner capabilities, automated scanning, consent records, compliance features and Google Consent Mode v2 integration.
- [Analytics](https://cookieinformation.com/analytics/): Privacy-first analytics powered by Piwik PRO, including anonymous tracking, attribution, dashboards, user journeys and raw-data access.
- [Compliance scanner](https://cookieinformation.com/scan-your-website/): Scan a website for cookies and trackers.

## Pricing and plans

- [Pricing](https://cookieinformation.com/pricing/): Current Essential and Business plan pricing, plan calculators, feature comparison, usage definitions and custom-plan information.
- [Business plan](https://cookieinformation.com/business-plan/): Details of and signup for the Business plan (Cookie Banner + Analytics).
- [Free trial](https://cookieinformation.com/registration/): Start a Cookie Information trial.

## Documentation

- [Support Center](https://support.cookieinformation.com/): Product documentation, implementation guides, customization help, compliance guidance, subscription information, partner resources, mobile consent documentation and FAQs.
- [Getting started](https://support.cookieinformation.com/articles/first-time-user-get-started/introduction-to-the-platform/create-a-consent-solution/): How to create a consent solution, add domains, select scan settings and configure languages.
- [Domain setup](https://support.cookieinformation.com/articles/first-time-user-get-started/introduction-to-the-platform/add-and-edit-a-domain/): Domain definitions, domain types and configuration.
- [Cookie Information + Piwik PRO setup](https://support.cookieinformation.com/articles/first-time-user-get-started/basic-implementation/set-up-cookie-information-piwik-pro-first-time/): How the CMP and Piwik PRO Analytics Suite work together.

## Optional

- [Blog](https://cookieinformation.com/blog/): Articles about consent management, privacy compliance, analytics, Google Consent Mode and marketing performance.
